title: Tensor-route computation in the ordinary homotopy model
statement: Use [def-weil-pbc-residue-exchange-comparison-interface], [new-integral-residue-tensor-presentation], [new-integral-residue-derived-monoidal], [new-integral-residue-tensor-model]. For prime ℓ, normed E over ℚ_ℓ, f:X→Y, a proof that ordinary integral pullback preserves flat objects, and any homotopy complex P of integral module sheaves on Y, compose the canonical tensor-route LF(tY) followed by the derived tensor comparison at QP and B_Y with the explicit target comparison of new-integral-residue-tensor-model. The result is the explicit model map defined there. No K-flatness of P or flatness of the residue coefficient is assumed.

Apply the generic tensor-model normalization equation to the actual category data and the fixed presentation counit of residueExchangeTensorIso. Its conclusion is exactly the canonical model equation for every homotopy complex P.

theorem integralResidue_tensorRoute_model {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hFlat : (f)^*⟦integralCoeff ℓ E⟧.PreservesFlat)
    (P : HomotopyCategory (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology Y) Ab.{u + 1})
      (condensedRingObj (integralCoeff ℓ E) Y)) (.up ℤ)) :
    letI := residueExchangePullMonoidal ℓ E f
      (residueExchangeOrdinaryPullMonoidal ℓ E f) hFlat
    let M := DerivedCategory.Qh.obj P
    (residueExchangeUpperStar (integralCoeff ℓ E) f).map
          ((residueExchangeTensorIso ℓ E Y).hom.app M) ≫
        Functor.OplaxMonoidal.δ (residueExchangeUpperStar (integralCoeff ℓ E) f)
          M (residueExchangeCoefficient ℓ E Y) ≫
        residueExchangeTensorModelTarget ℓ E f P =
      residueExchangeTensorModelMap ℓ E f P
